## Scope

The quality audit reviewed 190 second reads taken during the quarter. The review considered the relationship between the first and second grades recorded for each set. Its purpose was to provide a clear summary of grading consistency and to identify the results requiring individual follow-up. The audit was limited to the second reads included in the quarter’s review and does not present findings beyond that material.

## Result

Overall agreement between first and second grades was 71.6 per cent of sets. This result provides the aggregate view of grading consistency for the audit period. Detailed per-grader results are available in the attached spreadsheet. Those results are discussed privately with each grader so that the information can be considered appropriately and any relevant points can be addressed directly.
